fact: NGARi is building a Setswana AI commons in Gaborone, with an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor donated to and hosted at the Botswana University of Agriculture and Natural Resources, further units at Orange Digital Center and Botswana Accountancy College, and open Setswana models and datasets planned for release, completing in 2027 (status: build in progress, MOUs drafted, hardware scoped).
title: NGARi Botswana — The Setswana AI Commons
